description: This Java class serves as a command handler for deleting provisioning categories within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is annotated with @CommandType to specify the entity and action. The class utilizes a service 'ProvisioningCategoryWritePlatformService' to perform the delete operation within a transactional context.

classes.name: DeleteProvisioningCategoryRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles delete commands for provisioning categories, executing within a transactional context and delegating to the provisioning category service.

methods.name: DeleteProvisioningCategoryRequestCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the provisioning category write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete method on the provisioning category service, returning the result.
